task: multi-class aorta segmentation in CTA (AortaSeg24 challenge)
pipeline: two-stage: 3d_lowres binary aorta localization -> ROI (scaling factor m=2.0) -> 3d_fullres 24-class segmentation
layout: mirrors nnUNet_results/ and can be downloaded directly into it
citation: Shi, P. (2024). Hierarchical Semantic Learning for Multi-class Aorta Segmentation. In: International Challenge on Multi-class Segmentation of the Aorta. Springer, pp. 12-22.
